changes.comment: Restore useDebounced's legacy return type. It returned (...args: Parameters<T>) => void where v4 inferred the looser (...args: any[]) => void. The debounced function is normally handed straight to useControlEffect, whose V is inferred from compute, so precise parameters make a compute returning 'as const' produce a readonly tuple that strictFunctionTypes then refuses to pass to a handler declared with a mutable one — code that compiled on v4 fails to compile after the version bump.
